name: Spores
description: Clinging spores slow movement by 0.02 turn per stack, up to 10. Lasts 6 turns if not refreshed.

name: Primal Fury
description: You attack quicker by 0.02 turn and deal 4% more damage per stack, up to 8. Lasts 8 turns.

name: Hobbled
description: A torn leg slows movement by 0.05 turn per stack, up to 4. Lasts 5 turns.
